description: The line plot illustrates the similarity of HSAs (Hierarchical Softmax Approximations) in different languages across various layers within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and is linear, with a value range from 0 to 22, indicating the number of layers. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and is linear, with a value range from 0.00 to 0.45, representing the similarity score. There are four lines in the plot, each representing a different language combination: "en&en" in red, "en&es" in blue, "en&el" in green, and "en&bn" in purple. The "en&en" line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.35, and ends at approximately 0.45. The "en&es" line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.25, and ends at approximately 0.35. The "en&el" line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.15, and ends at approximately 0.25. The "en&bn" line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.15, and ends at approximately 0.25. All lines show a general trend of increasing similarity towards the later layers, with a significant peak at layer 22.
